decision_basis: Pre-registered three-seed rule met: 3/3/3 usable seeds at 600/800/1000 K, between-seed D max/min ≤ 1.11, per-seed Arrhenius R² ≥ 0.995.

Three-seed rule not met: usable seeds 0/3/2 at 600/800/1000 K (600 K seed 0 lag-window sensitive; 600 K seed 1 fit-region sensitive/lag-window sensitive; 600 K seed 2 lag-window sensitive; 1000 K seed 1 framework motion); 600 K Li MSD growth is only 1.7–2.9 Å², so no Ea or σ(300 K) is reported.

Seed 2 is excluded at every temperature because its 800 K conditional D changes 5.7× with the fit region; seeds 0/1 are usable at 600/800/1000 K (2/2/2) with between-seed D max/min ≤ 1.06 and per-seed Arrhenius R² ≥ 0.987, so the rule passes on two seeds only.
Pre-registered three-seed rule met (3/3/3 usable seeds at 600/800/1000 K, between-seed D max/min ≤ 1.13, per-seed Arrhenius R² ≥ 0.999), but mean σ(300 K) = 0.38 mS/cm is below 1 mS/cm.

Three-seed rule not met: usable seeds 1/3/3 at 600/800/1000 K (600 K seed 0 fit-region sensitive/lag-window sensitive; 600 K seed 2 fit-region sensitive/lag-window sensitive); 600 K Li MSD growth is only 3.7–5.3 Å², so no Ea or σ(300 K) is reported.
Pre-registered three-seed rule met: 3/3/3 usable seeds at 600/800/1000 K, between-seed D max/min ≤ 1.15, per-seed Arrhenius R² ≥ 0.985.
